name: element_symbols
description: Retrieve the chemical element name from its standard symbol; control copies an explicitly supplied element name.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
symbols='H He Li Be B C N O F Ne Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar K Ca Fe Cu Zn Ag Au Hg Pb Sn Ni Co'.split()
elements='hydrogen helium lithium beryllium boron carbon nitrogen oxygen fluorine neon sodium magnesium aluminum silicon phosphorus sulfur chlorine argon potassium calcium iron copper zinc silver gold mercury lead tin nickel cobalt'.split()
lookup=dict(zip(symbols,elements));items=[];control=[]
for r in range(3):
 for sym in symbols:
  ans=lookup[sym];p=[f'Chemistry: the element with chemical symbol {sym} is',f'Periodic table lookup. Symbol: {sym}. Element name:',f'The chemical symbol {sym} stands for the element'][r]
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+ans});control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the element name. Symbol: {sym}; element: {ans}. Element name:','answer':' '+ans})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
